jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT VITALIZE

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own custo




OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

 - 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

 - 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

 - 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

 - 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.




ABOUT VITALIZE'S CUSTOMER SUCCESS TEAM

Customer Success turns successful deployments into durable, growing partnerships. We own adoption, value realization, executive relationships, retention, and identifying opportunities to expand Vitalize across the health systems we serve.

Our CSMs become experts in their customers’ operations—working from the frontline to the C-suite to understand what matters, prove measurable ROI, and help health systems get more value from Vitalize over time. As our customer base grows, Customer Success will be central to making Vitalize an indispensable strategic partner to every health system we serve.




THE ROLE

You’ll join Vitalize’s early Customer Success team and own a portfolio of ~5–7 enterprise health systems. These are complex, multi-hospital organizations where Vitalize is deployed across thousands of frontline users and works with stakeholders from nurse managers to C-suite executives.

You’ll own the customer lifecycle from contract signature onward — partnering closely with Deployments through implementation and go-live, then leading the long-term relationship across workforce transformation, adoption, value realization, executive engagement, retention, and expansion. You’ll also work closely with Customer Support to ensure issues are resolved quickly and systematically.

As an early member of the team, you won’t just manage accounts. You’ll help define how Customer Success operates as Vitalize scales: what great account management looks like, how we measure and communicate value, and how we turn successful customers into durable, reference-able partnerships.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the end-to-end success motion for assigned health systems—from deployment handoff through adoption, value realization, and renewal

 - Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships across each account: C-suite sponsors, operational directors, and frontline champions

 - Run QBRs and executive check-ins that are grounded in data and tied to customer-specific KPIs

 - Act as a strategic consultant on workforce strategy—helping leaders connect Vitalize data to decisions on OT reduction, float pool optimization, and labor spend

 - Build ROI narratives that quantify the value Vitalize delivers (financial savings, operational efficiency, workforce outcomes), tailored to the audience (CFO, CNO, operations director)

 - Drive adoption across complex, multi-site organizations with non-tech-savvy users and competing priorities

 - Design ongoing education and training motions—not just initial rollout, but sustained engagement that keeps utilization high

 - Own the hard conversations when value isn't landing as expected, and work cross-functionally to course-correct

 - Translate customer conversations into actionable product insight—distinguish between custom configuration and productizable features, and bring structured feedback to the product team

 - Partner with Deployments to ensure clean handoffs, track leading indicators during go-lives, and embed early in new customer sites

 - Collaborate with Analytics to tailor reporting packages per account and ensure the right data is powering your executive conversations

 - Work with Support to surface systemic issues and ensure customer health isn't eroding below the surface




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years managing enterprise accounts or complex stakeholder environments—CS, consulting, implementation, or healthcare ops

 - Executive presence—you can run meetings with C-suite health system leaders, manage expectations, and have hard conversations about value delivery

 - Analytical rigor—you build ROI narratives from data, use metrics as leading indicators, and create reports that drive action (not just updates)

 - Multi-threading instinct—you naturally build relationships across stakeholder tiers (executive sponsor, operational leads, frontline champions) and tailor your approach to each

 - Startup mindset—you've operated in a high-growth, ambiguous environment where playbooks didn't exist and you had to build the motion

 - Willingness to travel—50% initially (customer site visits during deployments), 25% ongoing



BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible PTO

 - Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

 - Twice-yearly company off-sites

 - Free meals in the office

 - $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

 - Desk setup reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits

 - Monthly gym/wellness stipend

 - An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT VITALIZE

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers..



OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

 - 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

 - 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

 - 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

 - 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.




ABOUT VITALIZE'S MARKETING TEAM

We're looking for our first Head of Marketing to build the function from the ground up. You'll define the strategy, establish how marketing operates, determine where we invest, and hire the team that will help take Vitalize through its next stage of growth.

In the beginning, you'll do a little bit of everything. You'll spend time with customers, launch campaigns, shape product positioning, partner closely with Sales, build our brand, and create the playbook that future marketers will inherit. Over time, you'll build the organization around you. You'll decide which capabilities to hire first, how the team should evolve, and what great marketing looks like at Vitalize. This isn't an opportunity to manage an existing team; it's an opportunity to build one.



THE ROLE

Marketing should become one of Vitalize's primary growth engines. As the marketing leader, you'll own the function end-to-end. You'll bring an operator's mindset to the role, owning the strategy to drive enterprise pipeline, shape how the market understands Vitalize, support our sales organization, launch new products, build our employer brand, and establish us as the defining company in healthcare operations.

This is a true builder's role. You'll define the strategy, establish the operating cadence, hire great people, and create the systems that allow marketing to scale. At the same time, we expect you to remain deeply connected to the work itself. You should enjoy interviewing customers, writing positioning, reviewing creative, digging into data, partnering with Sales, and launching campaigns just as much as building teams and setting strategy. We're looking for a leader who believes the best executives never become too far removed from the craft.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build the marketing organization—Our marketing organization does not exist at the moment. You'll design the strategy, define how the team operates, establish priorities, and hire exceptional people

 - Build a marketing engine that drives growth—Marketing exists to accelerate the business. You'll develop the playbook that consistently generates enterprise pipeline, strengthens our position in the market, enables our Sales team to win, and supports long-term revenue growth. You'll partner closely with Sales and Growth Operations to understand where growth comes from, identify where marketing can create leverage, and continuously improve the engine. Success in this role won't be measured by campaigns launched—it will be measured by business outcomes

 - Turn customer success into our greatest competitive advantage—We believe the best marketing we'll ever create won't come from us. It'll come from the clinical leaders whose hospitals we've transformed. You'll spend time with customers, visit hospitals, listen to implementation calls, and deeply understand how Vitalize changes healthcare operations. Those insights will become the foundation for everything we create—from demand generation to thought leadership

 - Shape how the market understands Vitalize—You'll define how customers, candidates, investors, and the broader healthcare industry understand who we are. That includes product marketing, positioning, launches, communications, employer brand, customer advocacy, executive events, and public narrative. Every story we tell should be grounded in real customer outcomes and reinforce why Vitalize is becoming the category leader in healthcare operations

 - Build a team people want to join—As the company grows, you'll recruit and develop high-performing marketers who combine ambition with humility, ownership with curiosity, and creativity with execution




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - High-growth B2B SaaS experience—You've built and scaled marketing at a high-growth B2B SaaS company. You know how to create a strategy, establish an operating cadence, and build the systems that allow marketing to scale alongside the business

 - Marketing engine expertise—You understand how demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, brand, communications, events, and sales enablement work together to drive enterprise growth—and how those priorities evolve as a company grows

 - Enterprise SaaS expertise—You've marketed complex products with long sales cycles, multiple executive stakeholders, and high-value deals. You know how marketing partners with Sales to influence meaningful pipeline and revenue

 - Customer obsession—You naturally spend time with customers, uncover what matters most to them, and turn those insights into positioning, campaigns, product launches, and compelling stories

 - Team building—You know how to hire, develop, and coach high-performing marketers while creating a culture of ownership, curiosity, and high standards

 - Player-coach mindset—You enjoy setting strategy, but you're equally excited to write messaging, review creative, launch campaigns, analyze pipeline, and stay close enough to the work to know what great looks like

 - Judgement—You know how to prioritize, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and focus your team's energy on the highest-leverage opportunities instead of trying to do everything




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible PTO

 - Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

 - Twice-yearly company off-sites

 - Free meals in the office

 - $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

 - Desk setup reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits

 - Monthly gym/wellness stipend

 - An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

jobs.title: VP, Customer Success & Delivery
jobs.description:
ABOUT VITALIZE

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $32M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.



OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story - interview with us to hear them!

 - 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

 - 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

 - 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort — we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

 - 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it — no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.



ABOUT VITALIZE'S POST-SALES

Our Post-Sales organization owns the customer lifecycle from signature through deployment, adoption, value realization, retention, and expansion. The org is currently comprised of three teams. Deployments gets customers live and to value quickly; Customer Success serves as the strategic partner to our customers, owning executive relationships, driving adoption and measurable value, and identifying opportunities to deepen and expand our partnerships; and Support keeps customers successful day-to-day.

This isn't traditional software implementation. Vitalize changes how thousands of frontline staff, managers, staffing teams, and executives work every day. As we scale to 100+ hospitals, we need these three functions to operate as one system — delivering transformational change for our customers while becoming faster, more predictable, and more scalable with every deployment.




THE ROLE

As VP, Customer Success & Delivery, you'll lead our Customer Success, Deployments, and Support teams and own the outcomes of the entire post-sales organization.

You'll be accountable for getting customers live quickly, driving adoption and measurable ROI, delivering best-in-class retention, and growing our existing partnerships. Just as importantly, you'll build the organization that allows us to do this at significantly greater scale — developing leaders, hiring exceptional talent, improving how the three teams work together, and increasing the number of customers and ARR we can support per person.

You'll operate at every altitude: developing the strategy and operating system for Post-Sales, coaching leaders and ICs, making hard portfolio and resourcing decisions, and personally engaging with executives across our most strategic health system relationships.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and lead a world-class Post-Sales organization. Set the vision and strategy for Customer Success, Deployments, and Support. Develop exceptional leaders, raise the bar for talent, and evolve the organizational structure as we scale from dozens to hundreds of hospitals.

 - Own customer outcomes and the number. Be accountable for retention and NRR across our customer base, setting the strategy and standards for how we drive adoption, value realization, customer health, and growth. Build toward a future where Customer Success owns an increasing share of the expansion motion directly.

 - Create one cohesive customer lifecycle. Lead Deployments, Customer Success, and Support as one organization, establishing clear ownership and accountability from signature through deployment, adoption, renewal, and expansion.

 - Set the strategy for faster, more scalable delivery. Establish the vision for how Vitalize deploys increasingly complex customers with greater speed and predictability. Empower your leaders to build the systems, playbooks, and capabilities that improve time-to-value and capacity cycle over cycle.

 - Raise the bar for how we demonstrate customer value. Establish the standard for how Vitalize measures and communicates adoption, operational impact, and financial ROI — ensuring our customers and their executives understand the value we're creating.

 - Own our most strategic customer relationships. Build trusted relationships with CNOs, COOs, CIOs, CFOs, and other health system executives. Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic accounts and step directly into the moments where senior leadership can change the outcome.

 - Make the hard portfolio and investment decisions. Set priorities across customers, resources, and team capacity. Make clear tradeoffs about where we invest, what we commit to, and where we push back — and hold the organization accountable for those decisions.

 - Represent the voice of the customer at the company level. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to turn patterns across our customers into company strategy, balancing customer needs with building a scalable product and business.

 - Build for the next order of magnitude. Design the organization, leadership structure, and strategy required to support dramatically more customers and ARR — using product, automation, process, and customer ownership to create leverage rather than scaling headcount linearly.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - You've scaled a post-sales organization in a high-growth environment. You've hired, ramped, and built leadership layers as the company grew — and can speak concretely to what broke at each stage and how you adapted.

 - You've owned retention and NRR. You know how to translate adoption, customer health, executive relationships, and demonstrated value into retention and growth. Experience building a CS-led expansion motion is a plus.

 - You've developed strong leaders. You've coached managers, developed leaders from within, and evolved your org structure and talent as the company scaled.

 - You know complex enterprise delivery. You've led deployments requiring workflow change, integrations, training, executive alignment, and adoption across large organizations.

 - You can operate in the executive room and the weeds. You're as comfortable discussing ROI with a CFO or navigating an escalation with a CNO as you are diagnosing why an implementation is slipping.

 - You make hard tradeoffs. You can prioritize across competing customers and scarce resources, articulate a defensible rationale, and own the outcome.

 - You partner effectively with Product. You can turn patterns across customers into product signal without turning the roadmap into a collection of customer commitments.

 - You've built without a playbook. You're comfortable when the product, organization, and processes are all evolving — and see building the system as part of the job.

 - You understand healthcare, or can get there quickly. Health system experience — particularly in nursing, workforce management, or hospital operations — is a strong advantage. You understand the complexity of clinical workflows, stakeholders, and organizational dynamics.

 - Ability to travel. You’re excited to spend 40–50% of your time onsite with our customers.




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible PTO

 - Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

 - Bi-annual company off-sites

 - Free meals in-office

 - $5,000 relocation bonus

 - Desk setup reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits

 - Monthly gym/wellness stipend

 - An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water
